description: Land Acquisition - Yalagamuwa, Uvaparanagama D/S Division, Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette content is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purposes. It includes lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents, along with procedures for compensation claims. The content falls squarely under "Land and property-related matters" as defined for Type 4, specifically covering land acquisitions.
